scripts.clean: rimraf apps/vscode/out apps/vscode/views/chat-view/dist packages/protocol/dist packages/core/dist packages/daemon/dist packages/cli/dist
scripts.build:core: pnpm run build:protocol && pnpm --filter @leafrelay/core run build
scripts.build:daemon: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @leafrelay/daemon run build
scripts.build:vscode: pnpm run build:daemon && pnpm --dir apps/vscode run build
scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:daemon && pnpm --dir packages/cli run build
scripts.compile: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:protocol && pnpm --filter @leafrelay/core run build && pnpm --filter @leafrelay/daemon run build && pnpm --dir apps/vscode run build && pnpm --dir packages/cli run build
scripts.lint: eslint apps/vscode/src apps/vscode/test apps/vscode/views/chat-view/src apps/vscode/views/chat-view/*.ts packages --ext ts --no-warn-ignored
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
